company.name: Nightingale
company.shortDescription: Nightingale is the clinical decision support solution for evidence-based interventions.
company.description:
Nightingale is the clinical decision support solution for evidence-based interventions. They're committed to ensuring that service providers for individuals with autism and related disorders are equipped to administer high quality, personalized treatment. 

Product features include:

• Automatically generated data visualization and graphing 
• Automatically generated reports
• Digitized data sheets for paperless data collection
• Cloud-based collaboration via live data feed
• Fully customizable platform
• Available on any desktop, tablet, and smartphone • Accessible via online or offline mode
• Secure and HIPAA compliant, verified by Aptible

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $660,000, or 84.62% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,565,387 to $4,407,904, a 1.72x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
